about_short_description.short_description: Coulomb AI provides predictive battery analytics software for electric vehicles.

product.name: Battery Observability Platform
product.description: A platform offering comprehensive visibility and analytics for battery data across its lifecycle, aimed at optimizing performance and health.

product.name: Predictive Analytics
product.description: Utilizes machine learning to provide precise predictions on battery performance and health, enabling better lifecycle management.

product.name: ML-Based Anomaly Detection
product.description: Identifies underperforming batteries early through big data analysis, enhancing system safety and reliability.

product.name: Sustainability Assessment
product.description: Evaluates batteries for repurposing or recycling based on capacity and health metrics, supporting sustainable lifecycle management.

product.name: Warranty Management
product.description: Offers insights on battery health and usage patterns to manage warranties effectively and plan for maintenance and replacement.

product.name: Operational Excellence
product.description: Facilitates faster root cause analysis from high-level analytics to cell-level details, improving fleet performance and revenue.
